dispositions.finding: Return flight may overwrite home on retarget
dispositions.action: Fixed: returning-home ownership retained until completion; cancelled old jobs cannot clear replacement state. Expanded direct return test.

dispositions.finding: Reopening a topic resumes its prior branch
dispositions.action: Intentional: owner explicitly requires reading/playback position and branch-origin preservation. Per-target state begins at mapped revision on first entry and resumes the reader afterward.

dispositions.finding: Level key cancels an ongoing pinch
dispositions.action: Fixed: level is no longer a pointerInput key, gesture transitions preserve current camera instead of starting a competing flight. Test checks scale beyond the boundary in one gesture.

dispositions.finding: Ship fades out on local map
dispositions.action: Intentional orbital location: the globe and its parked ship crossfade together into the surface map; Back restores orbital location. No ship teleports onto the continent.

dispositions.finding: Inspection allows pointer input beneath it
dispositions.action: Fixed: full-area dismiss target consumes outside taps before they reach the atlas.
